name: The majority voted against the following [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2016-03-02.11.2): > *The question now is that the amendment moved by Senator Collins be agreed to.* Senator [Jacinta Collin](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/jacinta_collins)'s [amendment](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2016-03-01.3.2) was the following: > *At the end of the motion [which is "That this bill may proceed without formalities"], add, "but, may not be further proceeded with until 12 May 2016."* In other words, Senator Collin's motion was to delay the passage of this bill through the Senate until at least 12 May 2016, but it was unsuccessful.
